admission.justification: Browser send and server composition jointly deliver one ordered whole message per chosen target, guarded by API and send-snapshot tests.

applicability: One captured browser Send to each explicitly chosen existing AR recipient.
conditions: Each target gets a developer first line naming its task when present, then the free text, then numbered picks in tray order with each note.
References use their exact written forms; text picks become titled native text attachments with provenance, and image picks become native image entries.
The browser sends one complete body per target and handles each target’s answer independently; a target refusal does not suppress the other chosen sends.
exclusions: No per-pick chat turns, role_message impersonation or host-owned new composer.
A native attachment being prepared does not prove the recipient has viewed it.
Recipient lifecycle and capacity refusals remain owned by native delivery.
